single_change: Relative to covariance_feedback: replace only two COCO hip observation rows by one symmetric, frozen2-parameter virtual-joint map after frame10.
unchanged: frame0 pose, beta, pixels, dt, VPoser sigma0.75, all gates,15-step optimizer and conditional state mean

success: 35..61 mean ankle rise <30mm AND same-window hip pixel median improves >=20%, all62 poses available; no new restart. Otherwise do not promote or run448.
limits: Linearized covariance is an approximation, not proof of exact MAP convergence or calibrated uncertainty. No ground/contact/3D target. Virtual COCO points are detector landmarks, NEVER anatomical joint centers. Evaluate native pelvis separately; this diagnostic cannot certify anatomy. Shared shape beta was precalibrated using the original full sequence; held-out frames refer only to the new2-parameter hip calibration,not independent shape/3D validation.
stop: One complete448 pass of the successful prefix candidate, no sweep/retry.
calibration: Read two frozen weights from the completed prefix calibration, apply after frame10; no refit or later-frame calibration.
validation: Frames11..61, primary35..61. Do not use calibration residual for success.
generalization_gate: Full raw-slot median <= original*1.05, P95 <= original; hip median decreases>=20%; no new missing/restarted pose. Inspect every long static segment, retain all failures. These are engineering gates, not anatomical accuracy.
